scientific_integrity: Exact analytic mean integrals and threshold/tail proofs; accompanying symbolic checks and deterministic flow tests support but do not certify universal mathematics; prior model and current laws fully attributed.
scientific_limitations: Only three-state normalized zero-self-loop stationary discrete-time flows and two Euclidean-uniform ensembles; no general trajectory fluctuation theorem, higher-state universality or unrestricted-tail prefactor; novelty remains best-knowledge and independently unaudited.
title: Exact dissipation expectations and tail exponents in the three-state stationary-flow hyperensemble
